niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces that feel structured, polished, and intentionally organized, with clear hierarchy, coherent sectioning, and complete-looking content. They repeatedly favor calm, refined presentation over noisy or decorative layouts, often preferring reduced hero imagery, clearer content chunking, stronger row/list discipline, and softer or more restrained accent treatments. They also value screens that feel finished, balanced, and easy to scan, with visible functional payoff rather than sparse or ambiguous compositions.

criteria.description: Prefers strong information hierarchy with clearly separated sections, labeled groups, progressive content structure, and easy top-down scanning.
Prefers screens where rows, cards, and controls look fully specified, intentional, and refined, avoiding truncated, empty, or unresolved elements.
Prefers text-first or minimally decorative headers and dislikes large photo banners, promotional hero treatments, and ornamental clutter that competes with functional content.
Prefers content split into orderly, well-spaced modules or grouped sections with strong compositional balance rather than fragmented, top-heavy, or loosely assembled layouts.
Prefers a calm, composed, editorial or utilitarian aesthetic over playful, flashy, promotional, or overly stylized presentation.
Prefers softer, more nuanced iconography and accent usage—often pastel or restrained—rather than loud, saturated, or visually aggressive color treatments.
Prefers simpler, more focused screens and modals that isolate the main task or decision, with fewer competing elements and less surrounding distraction.
